text: With promises of victory and money, this unit can motivate nearby allies - until things go very very wrong.
Paymaster
While not the most adept at directly fighting the enemy, this character will motivate allies and hinder enemies.
Battle Support
Someone may call it cowardice, skirmishing tactics, support from the rear; be as it may, this character can actively avoid melee combat.
Skirmish
A life in the gutters or worse teaches that dust, spit and generally unsporting moves are all fair weapons in war and... war.
Dirty Fighters
This unit is mobile and can cause substantial damage, but can rarely win a fair fight. As such, they are better employed when they aren't the focus of the enemy's attention.
Guerrilla
Blades of the Ancients
The Amazons wield sacred blades from the High Age. Their power grants mystic protection, as well as increased weapon damage and charge bonus.
Cloak and Dagger
The peculiar dual wielding technique native to Tilea is used to perfection by Vespero's men. The dagger-hand beguiles and distracts the foe with a strip of cloak until one of the blades strikes home.
Leader of Renown
The commander of this troop is a famous leader. They may be much more resilient and powerful than the rest of the unit, and may confer special abilities.
Disgusting
This unit, although not monstrous by nature, will still make both allies and foes in the proximities quite uncomfortable.
[[img:ui/common ui/unit_category_icons/missile_infantry_bow.png]][[/img]]Death or Riches!
Lost Legion troopers are skilled in both pike and crossbow, and both weapons will be present in the regiment. \\nThe main pike unit comes with a squad of legionnaires armed with crossbows.
Calibre Isn't Everything

With the breakthrough of Bronzino's techniques, small and light cannons like these can be limbered up and move across the battlefield at the speed of horse. \\n\\nHowever, the reduced crew makes the unit even more vulnerable than normal.
Target-Rich Environment
This experimental vehicle may be slow, ugly, and unpleasant for the crew. But it doesn't know the meaning of 'surrounded', especially when it comes to infantry.
Quick Learner
This unit requires less experience to rank up than its peers.
Long Lances

To the more-or-less coarse jokes among the ranks, Tilean knights often wield cavalry lances that are longer than average. These have proven to be effective [[img:ui/skins/default/modifier_icon_bonus_vs_large.png]][[/img]] against enemy cavalry, even against Bretonnian jousters!
Curse of Estragon's Island

Cathayan weaponry and years of conquests are not the only things that make the Pariahs worthy of notice. What appears to be luck that protects them from lethal blows may be driven by a sinister fate, and many Pariahs suspect that their souls are forfeit.
Generalist Anti-Large

Compared to similar units, this unit has a smaller [[img:ui/skins/default/modifier_icon_bonus_vs_large.png]][[/img]]damage bonus against large entities but compromises through having better baseline stats, dealing better against smaller targets.
